service_categories.title: Finance & Insurance
service_categories.text: To succeed you need capital, and risks need to covered. Mqulima connects you to both. We get you credit that gets your season moving to insurance that protects what you’ve built, your financial future in agriculture starts here.

service_categories.title: Soil services
service_categories.text: Great harvests start below the surface. They start before any seed is bought. Mqulima’s soil services tell you exactly what your land needs and what to do about it before you plant a single seed.

service_categories.title: Crop services
service_categories.text: From the land you farm on to the market you sell into, Mqulima’s crop services cover every stage of the journey. From land preparation, through harvesting to storage, machinery, expertise and more built around getting you to harvest the best possible outcome.

service_categories.title: Animal & Health services
service_categories.text: Healthy livestock is the foundation of a thriving herd. Mqulima connects you to breeding, diagnosis and treatment expertise so your animals and your income stay protected.

service_categories.title: Animal Nutrition
service_categories.text: What you feed your animals determines what they give back. Mqulima helps you formulate, source and manage the right nutrition, at the right scale, every time.

service_categories.title: Irrigation services
service_categories.text: Water, delivered with precision. Mqulima connects you to the drilling, engineering and irrigation expertise that turns unpredictable rainfall into a farm you can rely on.

service_categories.title: Value Addition
service_categories.text: Raw produce earns raw prices. Mqulima helps you learn and apply value addition so what leaves your farm is worth more than what you planted. It doesn’t end at learning, it ends at the market and success.

service_categories.title: Important Services
service_categories.text: Some needs don’t fit neatly into a single category — but they still shape your success. From infrastructure to innovation, Mqulima brings these essential services within reach.

services.title: Agri loans & Credit
services.text: In agriculture, we understand harvesting isn’t every end month, so we give you access to credit built for the realities of farming- seasonal, flexible and sized to your enterprise. Get the capital moving before the planting window closes.

courses.title: Foundations
courses.text: Understand soil diagnostics, water budgeting, and variety seed selection before planting.
outcomes: Choose certified seed for your zone

lessons.title: Why soil testing pays for itself
lessons.summary: Most Kenyan farms lose 20–40% of fertilizer spend on nutrients the soil doesn't need. A soil test tells you pH, N-P-K and organic matter so every shilling goes where it counts.
points: Sample 15–20 spots per acre in a zig-zag
Mix and send 500g to the lab

lessons.title: How much water does a crop need?

courses.title: Crop Management
courses.text: Implement fertilizer application formulas and dynamic pest alert spray matrices.

lessons.title: Planting vs top-dressing explained
lessons.summary: Planting fertilizers (high phosphorus like DAP or NPK) build roots; top-dressing (nitrogen like CAN or Urea) drives leaf and grain growth. Timing matters as much as the product.
points: Apply planting fertilizer in the hole, not on the seed
Top-dress maize at knee height (4–6 weeks)

courses.title: Agripreneurship
courses.text: Gain market access benchmarks, post-harvest logistics, and export certifications.

lessons.title: Know your cost per kilo
lessons.summary: Profit starts with knowing exactly what each kilo or litre costs you to produce. Track inputs, labour, transport and losses for one season and you'll know your break-even price.
points: Record every input and labour cost
Divide total cost by total yield
Never sell below your cost per kilo
